scope: Static woven IL; labelled native paths, default bodies and exact physical native deltas. No live execution.

acceptanceRule.paths: Default and switched per-tool expanded native call graphs must equal the baseline.
acceptanceRule.default: The full-category member multiset must equal the baseline after collapsing each direct PLC blocks and compilation member into one local primitive site; no other delta is allowed.
acceptanceRule.shared: Engine PLC blocks and compilation direct sites move to deduplicated adapter primitives; only engine-required new members may be gained, with no change outside PLC blocks and compilation.
acceptanceRule.evidence: Generate per-member counts and declaring-method moves; physical equality before deduplication is informational.
